sentences.en: We tempted the old fox away from its burrow.
sentences.zh: 我们诱使那只老狐狸离开了它的巢穴。

sentences.en: A giant burrowing bat fossil has been discovered in New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 在新西兰发现了一只巨大的挖掘蝙蝠化石。

sentences.en: Lawyers began burrowing through thousands of documents provided by the defense.
sentences.zh: 律师们开始仔细查阅辩护方提供的数千份文件。
